annotations.title: Certify a rent roll against the leases, line by line

description: Certify a commercial rent roll for a lender or buyer: check each line of the roll, given as verified facts (each value with its verbatim quote and page from the rent roll document), against the leases' verified facts (and, where there is one, the answers of a confirmed estoppel), and grade it. Compares per line the tenant name, suite, rentable area, lease start and expiration, current base rent (per year, per month and per SF, the lease's worked from its rent schedule and area), next rent step, security deposit, free rent outstanding, renewal options and recoveries structure, wherever both the roll and a lease fact state it. Each line is graded: matches lease; matches lease and confirmed by tenant (the tenant agreed the premises, expiration and base rent statements of an estoppel); differs (both figures, the dollar difference and the quotes); no lease supplied; or not checkable, with the reason. A field no lease fact covers is not checked, never assumed. Totals: occupied and vacant area, occupancy, annual base rent as stated against as the leases yield and the difference, WALT (calc_walt, by area and by rent), rollover by year and top-tenant concentration. Flags: leases expiring within 12 months, tenants on the roll with no lease, leases with no roll line, rent on the roll above the lease, the roll's own arithmetic. Returns package_items and package_calculation for fact_package_send kind rent_roll. Deterministic, no model, no clock (as_of is an input). Facts and arithmetic, not legal, appraisal or lending advice: the certifying party's certification, not FactLot, is what the lender or buyer relies on, and FactLot checked the roll against the documents supplied only. On the hosted API the whole answer also carries attestation, the service's signature over the items, grades and figures that fact_package_send carries, so the FactLot record can show them as computed by FactLot and unchanged since; a service without a signing key returns none and says so. On the hosted API, callers without a Pro or Team key get the summary only (totals, key figures, grade counts, flags) and the answer says what is withheld. Each free, email-verified account (an fl_free_ key) gets one whole document in total across audit_expense_statement, estoppel_prepare and rent_roll_certify: that answer says so, and the report built from the same arguments is included for 24 hours; Pro and Team include every document with the monthly allowance.

as_of.description: The date of the rent roll, YYYY-MM-DD. The tool reads no clock: the current rent step, the leases expiring within 12 months and WALT are all measured from this date.

building_area_sf.description: Optional: the building's total rentable area. Vacant area is then the building area less the occupied area (stated as derived); with vacant lines on the roll as well, the two are compared and a difference is flagged. Must be greater than 0.

leases.description: The leases, one entry per tenant with the facts of the lease and its amendments.

estoppel.description: Optional: the tenant's answers to a confirmed estoppel for this lease (join estoppel_prepare's statement keys and codes with fact_package_status' answers). A line whose tenant, area, expiration and rent all match the lease is then graded confirmed by tenant only if the tenant agreed the premises, expiration and base rent statements and the estoppel speaks to the same rent step as the roll. A statement the tenant disputed makes the line differ. fact_package_send checks the estoppel with the FactLot record when the roll is sent.

as_of.description: The date the estoppel statements are as of.

package_id.description: The estoppel package's id from fact_package_send (kind estoppel).

code.description: The statement's code from estoppel_prepare: COMMENCEMENT, EXPIRATION, PREMISES, BASE_RENT, NEXT_RENT_STEP, SECURITY_DEPOSIT, FREE_RENT or OPTION_RENEWAL.

decision.description: The tenant's answer, as fact_package_status gives it.

facts.description: The lease's verified facts, with every amendment's (doc_abstract_lease, or doc_verify_facts), each with quote and page. Read by predicate: lease.tenant, lease.suite (text), lease.rentable_area_sf, lease.commencement_date, lease.expiration_date, lease.rent_commencement_date, lease.base_rent_schedule (steps {from, to, annual_rent_psf}), lease.security_deposit, lease.free_rent {months}, lease.renewal_option {count, term_months}, lease.recovery_structure {structure}, lease.operating_expense_base_year. A fact another fact supersedes is history; a fact with valid_from after as_of is pending and not used. A field no fact covers is not checked, never assumed.

label.description: A label for the lease, for the flags.

line_id.description: The roll line this lease is for. Without it the lease is matched to the one occupied line whose tenant name is the same (ignoring case and punctuation); an unmatched lease is flagged, never guessed.

certifier.description: The party that certifies the rent roll.

organisation.description: The organisation's name as the documents use it.

role.description: Who certifies the roll: the borrower or seller (or the broker acting for one). The certifier asserts the roll; the lender or buyer relies on the certifier's certification.

relying_party.description: The lender or buyer the certification is for, if known.

organisation.description: The organisation's name as the documents use it.

label.description: The property in words: name and address.

title.description: The rent roll's title as printed, for the report.

facts.description: The line's verified facts from the rent roll document, each with its verbatim quote and page and passing fact_validate, one fact per predicate: rent_roll.tenant_name (text), rent_roll.suite (text), rent_roll.rentable_area_sf (SF), rent_roll.lease_start_date, rent_roll.lease_expiration_date, rent_roll.base_rent_monthly (USD per month), rent_roll.base_rent_annual (USD per year), rent_roll.base_rent_psf (USD per SF per year), rent_roll.next_rent_step {date, annual_rent_psf?, annual_rent?, monthly_rent?}, rent_roll.security_deposit (USD), rent_roll.free_rent_outstanding {months?, amount?}, rent_roll.renewal_option {count?, term_months?}, rent_roll.recoveries {structure: nnn|modified_gross|gross|base_year|other, base_year?}. A field the roll does not state is simply left out.

line_id.description: Your stable id for the line (for example L1 or the suite); unique in the roll.

occupancy.description: occupied (default) or vacant. A vacant line needs only its suite and area facts and is not graded.

annual_usd.description: A difference of annual base rent up to this many dollars is a match within rounding (monthly rent: one twelfth of it). Default 1.

psf.description: A difference of rent per SF up to this many dollars is a match within rounding. Default 0.01.
